kind: read-only navigation exercise in ordinary agent; not native host loading or model adoption test

reported_findings: No blocking contradiction or broken link on traversed paths. Optional reviewer assembly.toml was probed and absent; reader recognized it was not required. Root product pointers do not select an unspecified task baseline.
actions: Agent reported file reads and link-target inspection only; no editing, test/model execution, web or delegation.
limitations: Observed outcomes are summaries of the agent's returned answer, not raw full tool traces. Complete answer remains in conversation. No host discovery, permission enforcement or exact-model behavior conclusion.
